review_candidates.description: About Altruist Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. The opportunity Altruist is in the midst of an exceptional growth phase, and we are hiring a Staff Database Administrator to join our Cloud Infrastructure & Platform team. Our clearing and brokerage platform runs on a multi-terabyte Aurora PostgreSQL estate that is the system of record for hundreds of thousands of brokerage accounts, millions of positions, and hundreds of thousands of trades every day. This role owns the reliability, performance, and resilience of that estate through its next order of magnitude. You will lead our multi-region disaster recovery program for data stores, break critical domains out of shared clusters into dedicated ones, and re-architect our replication and data movement layer so it keeps up as volumes multiply. You will be one of two staff-level database engineers, working directly with engineering leadership and partnering with platform, data, security, and product teams. The role carries a lot of autonomy for design and implementation, and real influence over where our data architecture goes next. Your impact Own the production PostgreSQL estate end to end — multi-terabyte Aurora clusters across clearing, broker-dealer, and internal platform workloads — including capacity, performance, availability, and cost. Lead multi-region resilience for data stores: convert production clusters to Aurora Global Database, instrument replication lag against tiered RTO and RPO commitments, and own documented failover, failback, and recurring recovery drills. Drive database segmentation. Carve our most critical domains out of shared clusters into dedicated ones with their own read paths, so failover, upgrades, and blast radius are scoped per domain rather than per fleet. Architect for an order-of-magnitude increase in accounts, positions, and daily transaction volume: capacity modeling, tenant-aware partitioning and sharding strategy, per-domain read replicas, continuous aggregates and materialized views, connection pooling, and load testing ahead of demand. Own the upgrade program. Plan and execute major-version upgrades across the fleet with minimal downtime, and keep engine versions current enough that they never gate replication or recovery capability. Own change data capture and data movement — Debezium, Kafka/MSK, and AWS DMS — for throughput, lag, and correctness, including re-architecting single-threaded vendor replication paths into parallel, partitioned pipelines. Raise the bar on schema-change governance: review standards for migrations, index and locking review, and automated guardrails so unsafe changes are caught before they reach production rather than during market hours. Partner with security and compliance on encryption, row-level security, least-privilege access, and the evidence our SOC 1 and regulatory obligations depend on. Be a senior escalation point for database-driven incidents, and turn each one into a durable fix, a runbook, or an alert rather than a repeat. Build automation and AI-assisted tooling that makes routine database work self-serve for product engineers, and mentor engineers across the org on data modeling, query design, and operating databases at scale. What you bring Experience - 8+ years operating production relational databases at scale, ideally at a B2B financial services, fintech, or SaaS organization handling regulated or transactional data. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: query planning and optimization, indexing, partitioning, vacuum and bloat management, locking and concurrency, replication, and connection management. Hands-on experience running Aurora or RDS at multi-terabyte scale, including major-version upgrades, blue/green cutovers, and parameter and storage tuning. Proven multi-region disaster recovery design: defining and defending RTO and RPO targets, cross-region replication, promotion and failback mechanics, and validated backup and restore. Practical experience with change data capture and data movement — Debezium, Kafka, or AWS DMS — and with diagnosing replication lag and correctness issues. Comfort working as code: Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and version-controlled schema migration tooling such as Flyway or Liquibase. Strong observability instincts — you reach for pg_stat_statements, wait events, and dashboards before you reach for a guess. Education - Ideally a B.A. / B.S. in a relevant field such as Computer Science or a related discipline, but experience and understanding matter just as much. Staff-level scope - You set technical direction beyond your own work, lead multi-quarter programs across teams, and influence without needing authority to do it. Ownership - The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable. Superb communication - Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others. Resilience - We are inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way. Assurance - Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives. Creative problem solving - Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You are instinctually creative in your approach to finding solutions to roadblocks. Bonus points if you bring Expertise with AI (Claude) best practices, and an interest in building agentic automation for database operations. Experience splitting a monolithic database into domain-owned clusters, or introducing sharding to a multi-tenant system already in production. MySQL, Snowflake, ElastiCache/Redis, or OpenSearch operational experience alongside PostgreSQL. Kafka or Amazon MSK operations, including connector fleets and upgrade planning. Experience supporting a large-scale data migration or platform integration, including historic data conversion into a canonical model. In this context, we are looking for a D365 Solutions & Administration Manager with the ability to own the architecture and integrations of this finance application stack, ensure its technical and functional consistency, and guarantee its security and maintainability over time. This role is the technical cornerstone of the finance transformation — turning strategy into reliable, scalable solutions. The Responsibilities Participate in the design and maintain the data flow architecture between D365 and other platforms — integration patterns, refresh frequencies, error handling and rejection management. Own the implementation and evolution of cross-system connectors Define Group integration architecture standards (middleware layer, API management, protocols). Assess the impact of system upgrades (D365 releases) on the integration architecture and drive the necessary adaptations. Develop the documentation of the architecture and keep it up to date as deployments progress across the 80 entities. Administer the D365 Finance & Operations platform at Group level: environment management (production, UAT, sandbox), update deployments, second-level incident management. Define, assign and maintain security roles and access rights in D365 in accordance with the principle of least privilege and Segregation of Duties requirements. Ensure D365 configuration remains aligned with the Group core model and document approved derogations. Act as the primary technical point of contact with Microsoft for administration, Premier Support and D365 Finance roadmap topics. Configure and maintain Group D365 financial settings: Chart of Accounts, financial dimensions, organisational structures, legal entities. Provide second-level functional support to local finance teams on configuration and integration topics. Support the standardisation of P2P, O2C and month-end close processes in D365, working closely with Finance Transformation and Consolidation teams. Explore and implement D365 Copilot AI agent capabilities (Copilot Studio) to automate high-value tasks: data matching, anomaly detection, close assistance. Ensure data quality at source in D365: completeness of analytical dimensions, referential consistency, flow anomaly detection. Work closely with the Finance Hub Data Engineering team to ensure data extracted from D365 to the data warehouse is reliable and structured in line with the Group data model. Contribute to compliance audits (internal control, SOX) covering the D365 technical perimeter and integrations. review_candidates.title: Lead Integrations Engineer
review_candidates.description: We’re Pret: proud makers of freshly made food, organic coffee, and big ideas. Across 750+ shops and 20+ countries, our teams are shaping the future of Pret through innovation, inclusion, great customer service and a shared passion for doing the right thing. We’re growing fast on our mission to be the employer of choice in hospitality, everywhere we operate – so this an exciting time to hop on board. We Believe in Growing Good Things Growth is at the heart of everything we do. From the freshly hand-made food we create every day, to supporting our teams, we help our people grow in confidence, skills and to pursue their unique paths. Pret is where passionate, hardworking, wonderful people (like you!) find what they need to shine. And the proof is in the pudding – over 80% of our Managers started on the shop floor! So did 20% of our Support Centre teams, including our CEO, Pano. What we’re looking for We’re looking for passionate team players to bring joy to our customers every day. As a Lead Integrations Engineer, you’ll set the standards and patterns the Integrations Engineers follow across our Azure integration stack (APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid), line-manage the team, and personally deliver the most complex and highest-risk flows in the estate. All new integration assets at Pret are being built on Azure; the legacy MuleSoft Anypoint estate is in a controlled wind-down through this programme. You will own that migration end to end and keep the legacy MuleSoft flows safely operational and well-led until they retire. Expect to spend roughly half your week in code, building, debugging, reviewing pull requests, pairing with engineers and the other half on architecture, standards, vendor conversations, team leadership and stakeholder engagement. This is the key technical leadership role for integrations at Pret. Reporting to the Head of Data & Integrations, you will lead Pret's Integrations team and own the target architecture that connects our SaaS platforms, including Workday, Oracle Symphony, NetSuite and e-commerce systems, with our data, finance and operational platforms. You will also be responsible for building the team's most complex integrations yourself, using the same tools and technologies as the rest of the team. We are not looking for a hands-off manager. This role is for a senior engineer who has grown into leadership without losing their technical edge. You will have led an integrations team working across both MuleSoft and Azure and understand first-hand what it takes to migrate an integration estate from one platform to the other without disrupting the business. If your last hands-on Azure integration build was three years ago, this is probably not the role for you. But if you still enjoy tackling a challenging Function App on a Friday afternoon while also developing and mentoring a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you. Key Responsibilities Act as the technical owner for the integration’s estate: the single accountable engineering voice on integration architecture, standards and delivery, reporting to the Head of Data & Integrations. Line-manage the Integrations Engineers (FTE and FTC): own performance, development, one-to-ones, and the team's engineering culture. Own the integration architecture for Pret's SaaS source systems and internal services, including Workday, Oracle Symphony, NetSuite, ecommerce platforms and others. All new build is on Azure. Personally design and build the hardest, highest-risk integrations on the Azure integration stack (APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid). Lead the team through the controlled wind-down of the legacy MuleSoft Anypoint estate: keep it safely operational while in use, sequence and migrate flows onto the Azure stack on the programme timeline and decommission cleanly. Define and enforce integration patterns and standards across the team: API design, event-driven flows, retry / error handling, idempotency, observability, security all anchored on Azure-native services. Produce reference implementations on the Azure stack that the team builds from APIM API templates, Function App patterns, Service Bus topologies, deployment pipelines. Run a healthy engineering practice in the team: review every non-trivial pull request, pair on the hardest pieces, unblock the team in code where needed, and grow more junior engineers. Build and maintain the team's engineering toolchain on Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, test frameworks, observability dashboards in Application Insights and Log Analytics. Work with the Data Engineering on the boundary between integration and data engineering, which data lands where, in what shape, on what cadence. Define and maintain the API and integration catalogue: what we have, who owns it, what it does, what SLA it runs to. Manage supplier and vendor relationships across the integration stack, including Microsoft, the MuleSoft wind-down, and any third-party connectors. Be the senior technical voice in vendor and SaaS conversations on integration capability. Act as senior technical escalation point and on-call backstop for major integration incidents, including evenings and weekends where required. Expect to be the one in the flow on Sunday night when a Workday-to-NetSuite job has fallen over. Report progress, risks and architectural decisions clearly to the Head of Data & Integrations and to programme leadership. Stay current with developments in Azure integration services and bring practical, working recommendations back to the team ideally as proof-of-concept code. Essential Experience and Skills required 6+ years' experience in integration / API engineering, with a recent track record of personally designing AND building production integrations on Azure. This is a builder-manager role. Proven experience leading an integrations team across both MuleSoft and Azure — line-managing or technically leading a team of integration engineers through the delivery and operation of a real estate on both platforms, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers. Demonstrable experience leading an integration estate off MuleSoft Anypoint and onto Azure: sequencing the migration, keeping the legacy flows stable and supported through the transition, and decommissioning cleanly. Note: our MuleSoft estate is in a controlled wind-down. We need someone who can lead and operate it safely to retirement, not someone whose primary strength is new MuleSoft build. Deep, current, hands-on experience building production integrations on the Azure stack: APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps (C# or Node.js), Service Bus, Event Grid, and the supporting Azure platform (Key Vault, Managed Identity, Application Insights, Log Analytics). You should have committed Azure integration code in the last 12 months. Strong API design skills (REST, JSON, OpenAPI) and event-driven patterns implemented on Azure services with examples of what you've built, not just designed. Demonstrable experience designing AND personally building integrations with enterprise SaaS systems ideally including Workday, Oracle Symphony, NetSuite, Salesforce or comparable systems. Strong understanding of API security on Azure, OAuth 2.0, JWT, mutual TLS, Managed Identity, Key Vault, APIM policies applied in real implementations you have built or led. Demonstrable experience setting and enforcing engineering standards across a team of integration engineers by example and by code review, not by document alone. Strong commercial awareness understands Azure consumption cost drivers, vendor commercials and TCO of integration choices. Excellent written and verbal communication; able to write a clear architecture decision record AND a clean pull request description, and to brief senior stakeholders in plain language. Comfortable working flexibly during critical delivery windows or major incidents, including evenings and weekends where required. Right to work in the UK without sponsorship. Desirable Microsoft Azure certifications, particularly the Azure Solutions Architect Expert or the Azure Developer Associate. MuleSoft certification (MCD / MCIA) alongside current Azure delivery. Experience personally building Azure integrations with Workday, Oracle Symphony or NetSuite. Experience migrating an integration estate off another legacy platform (BizTalk, Tibco, Boomi or similar) as well as MuleSoft. Experience with event-driven architectures at scale on Azure. Experience defining Azure landing-zone or platform-level standards (networking, identity, observability) for an integration estate. Experience in retail, hospitality, QSR or omnichannel. About You Be kind, honest and generous: bring genuine warmth and your authentic self to work every day. Bring your passion: share our passion for food and exceptional customer service. Spread joy every day: small acts of kindness are a big part of what makes the Pret experience special. We offer Competitive Salary and 20% bonus potential Gold Card: We love making people’s day through our food and drinks. That goes for our teams too. That’s why everyone gets a Gold Card. When you’re in the office, your food and drinks are on us. And when you’re not, you can use your Gold Card to get up to 5 Barista-made drinks a day, and 50% off everything else (food, snacks, bottled drinks – the lot). A few more perks You’ll get 33 days of annual leave (including flexible Bank Holidays), increasing to 38 days the longer you’re with us. Free private medical cover, with the option to add family or partner at an additional cost 4% of your pension contribution matched by Pret, rises to 5% after 5 years Life assurance at 3x annual salary Loyalty award for 5, 10, 15, 20 years’ service Flexible Benefits Platform packed with lifestyle discounts Season ticket loans Healthcare cash plan Financial wellbeing provisions Free mortgage services Sabbatical after 3 years Opportunities to support our charity, The Pret Foundation We also offer Individual ways to grow - We offer lots of opportunities for learning, whether you join us for a short stint or the long game, you’re good to grow with us. Including fully funded professional qualifications, leadership development and mentoring. Diversity and belonging - Everyone is welcome at Pret, we want you to feel confident and valued for who you are and to truly belong. Pace and variety - Our work is fast paced with lots of variety, you’ll build a diverse skill set and learn a lot! Community and purpose - We’re proud to make a difference through The Pret Foundation, from tackling homelessness to reducing food waste and creating positive change for people and communities. Our values Happy Teams Happy Customers Amazing Standards Every day Never Standing Still Doing The Right Thing The interview journey Every interview process at Pret begins with the same two stages. First, you’ll have a relaxed 30-minute conversation with our recruitment team so we can get to know you and your experience. Next, you’ll be invited to a one-hour, in-person interview with the hiring manager at our Head Office in London Victoria. Depending on the role and function, there may be additional stages. These could include time spent in one of our shops, completing a task, or meeting a senior leader. Before you apply This role is based at Pret’s Support Centre in London Victoria, where we work in a hybrid way - typically three days a week in the office. We’d love to get to know you, not a robot, so please do not rely on AI to complete your application. Deadline to apply for this role: 21st September 2026 - Please note due to a high volume of applicants we may close the role early, apply early to avoid disappointment.
